recipes.name: Asian Side Salad
ingredients: 1 tbsp soy sauce ((light or all purpose, not dark soy))
3 tbsp peanut oil ((or canola, vegetable or other neutral oil))
instructions: Shake Dressing ingredients in a jar.
Place Salad ingredients except fried shallots in a bowl. Drizzle with Dressing and toss.
Sprinkle with fried shallots and served immediately!

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: 1. Crispy fried shallot pieces – great garnish for Asian salads. Found in the Asian section of supermarket but cheaper at Asian stores! Substitute with roughly chopped nuts like cashews or almonds. 2. Nutrition per serving.
